title: ABC Belarus got rejected from the Anarchist Bookfair in Bremgarten, Switzerland. Here’s how you can support us
content: This year, we applied to participate in the Anarchist Bookfair in Bremgarten with a presentation on repressions in Belarus and our distro table. We were rejected «because of the war topic». As we have not received further rationale behind rejecting our request, we can only guess this relates to our stance on the war in […]
